errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line drops to 9 in 2008, but the chart shows the value for the blue line ('Брой държави в света') at the point near 2008 is 14. The value 9 belongs to the orange line in that year.
The description states that the blue line's value is 29 in 2018, but the chart clearly labels this point as 40.

The description incorrectly states that the blue line reaches its final value of 57 in the year 2023. The data point labeled 57 is located around the year 2020 on the x-axis, and the data line does not extend to 2023.
The description states that the orange line drops to 6 in 2008, but the chart shows its value in 2008 is 9. The value drops to 6 at a later point, around 2010.

The description incorrectly states that the orange line reaches its final value of 33 in the year 2023. The data point labeled 33 is located around the year 2020 on the x-axis, and the data line does not extend to 2023.
